Sub-lanes are names (routing), not identities, and are not separately keyed; every sub-lane's signing resolves to 8374's one SKAP specimen (SKI-SIGNING_KEY-31c77c60).

pricing.fee_position: The fee is the fee: a posted, non-negotiable toll (principal, 2026-11-16 23:52 CST). Negotiation concerns the work and the terms of the crossing, never the governance fee. Current posture, revisable by later principal determination.

modes.description: Mode (a): the fee is charged per evaluation regardless of outcome — ALLOW, DENY, and FAIL_CLOSED each bear the fee for the unit of compute consumed.
Mode (b): the ALLOW disposition price covers all dispositions; refused evaluations draw no separate charge and their compute is paid through the ALLOW price.

full-evaluation.basis: Complete admissibility evaluation at the signing boundary. Analysis cost basis $0.007-0.024 per evaluated outcome (2026-11-08); configured value is the analysis midpoint.

receipt-only.basis: Receipt-pair issuance and record only. Analysis figure: well under $0.001 per governed crossing (2026-11-08 sizing analysis). Configured value sits inside the analysis bound.

settlement.settlement_note: authorization verified at crossing; settlement is submitted by the endpoint's gas-only relayer over the Base public RPC and the outcome (tx hash, or a named SETTLEMENT_* failure code) is receipted in the crossing's pair. The relayer holds no USDC; it pays gas only.
